pathBase: paths resolve relative to this JSON file directory
reviewMethod: Primary rights/source revision pinning before bounded download, author/event grouping and deterministic role assignment before visual annotations or scores; model-blind timestamped image inspection. Source milliseconds are pinned FFmpeg PTS; downstream OpenCV mapping is explicit.
limitations: Provisional assistant visual review, not human ground truth. Contact subspans explicitly marked all-frame were inspected as every chronological decoded frame. Wider positive spans interpolate between visually consistent nearby samples; real-time video playback was not performed.
Sports/practice contact is a physical-contact proxy. Hostility, intent, injury, identity, guilt and crime are not annotated.
No model scores were opened and no detector, model, training or CUDA job was run for selection or annotation.
Actor/session independence and overlap with any publisher model pretraining remain unknown. Source author/event grouping is conservative, not proof of independence.
Copyright grants are uploader/author assertions on pinned primary Commons file pages; no independent participant/model releases or consent verification.
Original uploaded coded dimensions are verified; original camera-native raster and sensor modality are unknown. These are sports/practice videos, not certified CCTV/night/crowd operational evidence.
All unannotated margins, tails, occlusions and uncertain intervals remain unknown; audio was not used.
Six eligible clips from three conservative source groups; two downloaded candidates excluded. All frozen candidate groups happened to hash to reserved-audit; no development groups contributed.

Execution deviation: the dense and all-frame CPU evidence utilities briefly overlapped on the last two sources after the first process yielded. Each used one decoder and cv2 threads=1; no model/GPU job occurred. Other decoding passes were sequential.
